_about: Writes any MCP agent may make through chewbacca-mcp's kit_write tool. A reversible write runs at once, snapshots what it touches first, and returns an undo id for kit_undo. An outward write (a message, an email, a Slack post, any Clay write, anything that spends money) never fires from one call: kit_write returns a draft showing what goes out and to whom, and only kit_confirm with that draft's id sends it, through the tool's own gates (CHEWBACCA_NO_SEND, quiet hours, Caleb's Clay ok within 2 hours). Each entry's code lives in bin/lib/mcp-writes.js under the same id; tests/mcp_writes.sh checks the two agree. Caleb, 2026-10-11: "Never read only, find a way to write too".

writes.about: Add a task or todo to the work ledger. Undo deletes it, if nobody changed it since.
writes.asks: add todo task remember to do later commitment

workspace.about: A workspace path; leave out for a personal todo that shows everywhere

writes.about: Change a work ledger task's status, next action, evidence, reason or owner. Undo puts the old values back, if nobody changed it since.
writes.asks: update task mark done finished status next step

writes.about: Create an Apple Note, through Notes so it syncs. Undo moves it to Recently Deleted.
writes.asks: write a note save jot down apple notes

writes.about: Add a paragraph to the end of an Apple Note (ids from kit_read notes reads). Undo puts the note back exactly as it was.
Replace an Apple Note's title or body. Undo puts the note back exactly as it was.
Create a reminder in Reminders, optionally due at a time like 'tomorrow 9am'. Undo deletes it.
Tick off a reminder. Undo marks it not done again.
Put a tentative hold on the person's own calendar (titled 'Hold: ...', no invitees, so nobody is notified). Undo deletes it.
writes.asks: hold time block calendar tentative schedule put on calendar

writes.about: Record something about a person in the relationship store ('just got promoted'). Undo forgets it.
writes.asks: note about person remember fact relationship

writes.about: Create or replace a text file inside ~/second-brain, ~/Downloads or ~/Documents. The old bytes are backed up; undo puts them back (or removes a file it created).
writes.asks: write file save file create document

writes.about: Replace one exact passage in a text file inside ~/second-brain, ~/Downloads or ~/Documents. The old bytes are backed up; undo puts them back.
writes.asks: edit file change text in file

writes.about: Send a text, WhatsApp, Slack DM, email or any bridged chat to one person, through the app their thread is in. Returns a draft naming exactly who gets it and where; nothing sends until kit_confirm.
writes.asks: text send message email slack dm reply tell

writes.about: Any Clay write (add rows, run cells, add leads, blocklist, draft campaigns, replies): spends credits or emails people. Returns the exact request as a draft; kit_confirm sends it only with Caleb's ok in chat within the last 2 hours. A campaign start is never sent.
writes.asks: clay add leads rows enrich run cells campaign blocklist reply spend credits

args.about: The op's args as an object of strings, e.g. {"ws": "123", "table": "t_..."}
